extracted.intended_audience: health journalists, public health communicators, and consumers who evaluate health news
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluating health care news, advertising, marketing, public relations and other messages for accuracy, balance, completeness, and support for shared decision-making so consumers can make informed choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accurate, balanced and complete information about tradeoffs
rubrics_metrics.description: Information should be accurate, balanced and complete about the tradeoffs involved in health care decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site’s mission emphasizes promoting accurate, balanced and complete information about the tradeoffs involved in health care decisions as a cornerstone for improving public dialogue and enabling shared decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Help consumers critically analyze claims about interventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Content should help consumers critically analyze claims about health care interventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HealthNewsReview evaluates health care journalism, advertising, marketing, public relations and other messages that may influence consumers, and provides criteria that consumers can use to evaluate these messages themselves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote principles of shared decision-making
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage should promote and reinforce the principles of shared decision-making between patients and providers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation’s mission states: patients should be supported and encouraged to participate in their health care decisions; be fully informed about their care options using accurate, unbiased and understandable information; and have their personal goals and concerns honored. The site holds that high-quality medical decisions arise from a fully informed patient participating in shared decision-making with their provider.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial independence from funders
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain editorial independence from funding sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although funding for HealthNewsReview.org is provided by the Informed Medical Decisions Foundation, the page explicitly states the Foundation has no influence over the editorial operation of the project—signaling a standard of noninterference and integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: evaluate all messages that may influence consumers
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply evaluation criteria across multiple message types that could influence consumer decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site’s remit includes health care journalism, advertising, marketing, public relations and other messages that may influence consumers, indicating the rubric should be applied to reporting, PR, ads, and related communications.
